name: bio-mcp
description: Single-cell expression (CZ CELLxGENE Census) and CRISPR screen hits (BioGRID ORCS), plus the join between them, for AI agents.
long_description: An MCP server that answers, in one call: is this gene expressed in my cell type, and does knocking it out do anything? Human data only. Six tools over stdio. Census tools read precomputed tables (no 30GB download); the two ORCS tools need a free access key.

orcs_access_key.title: BioGRID ORCS access key
orcs_access_key.description: Optional. A free key from https://orcsws.thebiogrid.org/ enables crispr_screen_hits and screens_in_cell_line. Every Census tool works without it.

cache_dir.title: Data cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where the precomputed Census tables are stored. Defaults to ~/.cache/bio-mcp.
